body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Shehwa P&C(www.shehwa.co.kr), an optical film manufacturer, presented its LCD privacy film for mobile devices ‘Magic Screen’ during CES 2008, which makes the screen of the devices black when you see the screen from an angle greater than 30 degree.

As mobile devices like laptop, PMP and cell phone have wide usage in public places, the demand for the Magic Screen is rising, and it is also considered as the company’s flagship model for it is a low volume high value product.

With its high quality and cost competitiveness, the Magic screen has been exporting to global companies in more than 20 countries including USA, UK, Japan, and those in Middle East, as an OEM product.
(Picture: the privacy film makes the screen of mobile devices black when you see the screen from an angle greater than 30 degree)
(Picture: a company official is discussing with a buyer at the booth of Shehwa P&C at CES 2008)

“Shehwa and 3M are the only manufacturers of privacy films in the world. As the market size of the privacy film is becoming larger and larger, we’ll focus more on them and make top quality products,” the company said. “CES 2008 would be great opportunity for us to boost our brand image and to promote our products to global market.”
